headline: Guard note for rich/style.py edits
what_breaks: rich/console.py — relies on Style for terminal styles
rich/text.py — uses Style for text formatting
rich/table.py — depends on Style for table cell styling
why: The Style class is integral for defining terminal styles across multiple modules. Changes to its attributes or methods can affect how styles are rendered in the console and other components.
checklist: Review changes to the Style class and its attributes.
Check for any modifications to the _Bit descriptor behavior.
Ensure compatibility with dependent files like rich/console.py and rich/text.py.
